question: Question: Is the exact printed word {word} visible in this image? Answer yes or no. Answer:

scientific_choices.choice: Original local paper3.5/Figure4/Algorithm2 retains complete whole-image DeepSolo fallback. These six context probes are approximate extensions, not strict paper components.

Reuse the immutable audited425 YOLO640/PARSeq branches and grounded-context source: TRAIN80/VAL45, TEST300,983/2204 care words, exact-casefold multiset/native256 ignore, complete frozen DeepSolo ViTAEv2-S+TextOCR outcomes. Never edit word outputs.

Context transplantation preserves native target pixels plus a guard band, canvas coordinates and framing across original/neutral/dissimilar TRAIN-background views; keep a foreign-background-without-target negative control. Donors use only fitting TRAIN80 visual embeddings, excluding same RGB. This tests local context, not exact SceneFaith reproduction.

PARSeq conditional probabilities for the fixed predicted string use official forward/reverse/odd-even permutation masks and null context. This measures context sensitivity, not independent samples or calibrated correctness. EOS is saved and excluded from character summaries. No OCR candidate changes.

Last decoder cross-attention supplies monotonic character windows, which are spatial proxies, not character annotations or causal explanations. Same-line cross-word similar edge patches with contradictory labels produce a soft risk; absent evidence is explicitly missing.

Menu/price and hours/time English patterns supply partial structural risks only in detected compatible contexts. A lone time or price can be legitimate; no hard rejection, no inserted/missing word truth.

Approximate inverse graphics chooses one of six pinned fonts and three fixed angles from other confident same-line words, excluding the target; compare symmetric nearest-edge distances for target and foil. This prototype models font/line angle with gray-edge invariance, not a complete perspective/color generative renderer.

A TRAIN error memory uses kNN on frozen image embeddings or image-plus-standardized-core vectors, predicts deltaTP/deltaPred and excludes same IDs/RGB. It is supervised by TRAIN branch outcomes, with no new neural updates and no target or TEST labels in retrieval.

Seven feature ablations with Ridge/ExtraTrees plus two memory families and five frozen controls. Five-fold TRAIN80 CV selects model hyperparameters by final microF1; fold-only labels/scalers/references/memories. VAL45 chooses the family and scalar cut per20/30/50% quota; freeze before any new TEST probes. No refit125.

Actual RTX3090 FP32, sequential frozen PARSeq/BLIP2, vision batch1 and Yes/No batch2. Record allocated/reserved VRAM, state identity, input shape and incremental probe times. No dependency installation or model downloads.

Scarce80-image fit data, prior TEST exploration, source pretrained overlap, context-paste artifacts, weak VLM exact-spelling ability, imperfect attention alignment, font-bank coverage and partial structured scenes can limit gains. Report every arm, failures, partial evidence and confidence intervals; no guaranteed perfect separation or paper-superiority claim.

Inner CV groups identical original RGB hashes. Historical TRAIN80/VAL45 IDs remain unchanged. Retrieve excludes identical RGB even across TRAIN/TEST; the previously explored evaluation population is retained.

cv_protocol: GroupKFold by original RGB SHA256, no shuffle
